cobol_source:
*================================================================*
      * PROGRAM : VALIDATE                                             *
      * PURPOSE : APPLY DATA-QUALITY AND POLICY CHECKS TO EACH RECORD  *
      *           AND WRITE AN EXCEPTION REPORT                        *
      * INPUT   : data/input/employees.dat                             *
      * OUTPUT  : data/output/validation.rpt                           *
      *================================================================*
       IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. VALIDATE.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT EMP-FILE ASSIGN TO "data/input/employees.dat"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
           SELECT RPT-FILE ASSIGN TO "data/output/validation.rpt"
               ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD  EMP-FILE.
           COPY EMPREC.
       FD  RPT-FILE.
       01  RPT-LINE                PIC X(80).
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01  WS-EOF                  PIC X VALUE 'N'.
           88  END-OF-FILE         VALUE 'Y'.
       01  WS-MIN-WAGE             PIC 9(07)V99 VALUE 30000.00.
       01  WS-READ                 PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-CLEAN                PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-FLAGGED              PIC 9(03) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-ISSUES               PIC 9(02) VALUE 0.
       01  WS-DATE-NUM             PIC 9(08).
       01  SEP-LINE                PIC X(70) VALUE ALL "-".
       01  ERR-LINE.
           05  ERR-ID              PIC 9(05).
           05  FILLER              PIC X(02) VALUE SPACES.
           05  ERR-NAME            PIC X(20).
           05  FILLER              PIC X(01) VALUE SPACES.
           05  ERR-MSG             PIC X(40).
       01  SUM-LINE.
           05  SUM-LABEL           PIC X(24).
           05  SUM-COUNT           PIC ZZ9.
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
       MAIN-PARA.
           OPEN INPUT EMP-FILE OUTPUT RPT-FILE
           MOVE "EMPLOYEE DATA VALIDATION REPORT" TO RPT-LINE
           WRITE RPT-LINE
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM SEP-LINE
           PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE
               READ EMP-FILE
                   AT END SET END-OF-FILE TO TRUE
                   NOT AT END PERFORM CHECK-RECORD
               END-READ
           END-PERFORM
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM SEP-LINE
           MOVE "RECORDS READ:" TO SUM-LABEL
           MOVE WS-READ TO SUM-COUNT
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM SUM-LINE
           MOVE "RECORDS CLEAN:" TO SUM-LABEL
           MOVE WS-CLEAN TO SUM-COUNT
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM SUM-LINE
           MOVE "RECORDS FLAGGED:" TO SUM-LABEL
           MOVE WS-FLAGGED TO SUM-COUNT
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM SUM-LINE
           CLOSE EMP-FILE RPT-FILE
           DISPLAY "VALIDATE: " WS-FLAGGED " OF " WS-READ
                   " RECORDS FLAGGED"
           STOP RUN.
       CHECK-RECORD.
           ADD 1 TO WS-READ
           MOVE 0 TO WS-ISSUES
           MOVE EMP-ID   TO ERR-ID
           MOVE EMP-NAME TO ERR-NAME
           IF EMP-ID IS NOT NUMERIC OR EMP-ID = 0
               MOVE "INVALID EMPLOYEE ID" TO ERR-MSG
               PERFORM LOG-ISSUE
           END-IF
           IF EMP-NAME = SPACES
               MOVE "MISSING NAME" TO ERR-MSG
               PERFORM LOG-ISSUE
           END-IF
           IF EMP-DEPT NOT = "IT" AND NOT = "HR"
              AND NOT = "SALES" AND NOT = "FINANCE"
              AND NOT = "OPERATIONS"
               MOVE "UNKNOWN DEPARTMENT" TO ERR-MSG
               PERFORM LOG-ISSUE
           END-IF
           IF EMP-SALARY < WS-MIN-WAGE
               MOVE "SALARY BELOW 30,000 POLICY MINIMUM" TO ERR-MSG
               PERFORM LOG-ISSUE
           END-IF
           MOVE EMP-HIRE-DATE TO WS-DATE-NUM
           IF FUNCTION TEST-DATE-YYYYMMDD(WS-DATE-NUM) NOT = 0
               MOVE "INVALID HIRE DATE" TO ERR-MSG
               PERFORM LOG-ISSUE
           END-IF
           IF EMP-AGE < 18 OR EMP-AGE > 70
               MOVE "AGE OUTSIDE 18-70 RANGE" TO ERR-MSG
               PERFORM LOG-ISSUE
           END-IF
           IF WS-ISSUES = 0
               ADD 1 TO WS-CLEAN
           ELSE
               ADD 1 TO WS-FLAGGED
           END-IF.
       LOG-ISSUE.
           ADD 1 TO WS-ISSUES
           WRITE RPT-LINE FROM ERR-LINE.

plan.approach: The COBOL VALIDATE program is a sequential batch job that reads a flat employee file, applies six data-quality/policy rules to each record (CHECK-RECORD paragraph), logs each failure (LOG-ISSUE paragraph), and writes a summary report. The modernisation maps the file-read loop to a Spring Data JPA repository scroll over a PostgreSQL employees table; the six business rules become a dedicated stateless validator service; the flat-file report writer is preserved as a secondary output alongside a relational audit trail; and the program entry point is exposed both as a REST POST endpoint and as a CommandLineRunner (batch profile) to support both interactive and scheduled invocations.
patterns_used: Repository Pattern (Spring Data JPA) – replaces COBOL file I/O for employee source data and audit persistence
Service Layer Pattern – EmployeeValidatorService (CHECK-RECORD/LOG-ISSUE), ReportWriterService, ValidationOrchestrationService (MAIN-PARA)
DTO / Value Object – ValidationResult (per-record issue list), ValidationRunReport (run counters)
Command Pattern / CommandLineRunner – ValidationRunner reproduces COBOL batch execution under the 'batch' Spring profile
REST Controller – exposes trigger and query endpoints for interactive use
Flyway Database Migration – schema-as-code replacing the COPY EMPREC copybook definition
Single Responsibility Principle – each class maps to one COBOL paragraph or conceptual concern
plan.sql_strategy: The COBOL program reads from a flat file (LINE SEQUENTIAL). In the modernised version the employees table in PostgreSQL is the authoritative source of truth. Spring Data JPA (Hibernate) is used via EmployeeRepository.findAll() to iterate over all employee rows, directly replacing the PERFORM UNTIL END-OF-FILE / READ EMP-FILE loop. Validation issues and run summaries are persisted back to PostgreSQL through ValidationIssueRepository and ValidationSummaryRepository, providing a queryable audit trail that supplements the flat-file report. Flyway migrations (V1–V3) define the schema, preserving the field sizes and types from the COBOL EMPREC copybook.
plan.call_strategy: The original COBOL program contained no CALL statements to external programs; all logic was self-contained in two paragraphs (CHECK-RECORD, LOG-ISSUE). These paragraphs are converted to Spring @Service method invocations: CHECK-RECORD becomes EmployeeValidatorService.validate(Employee), LOG-ISSUE is inlined as ValidationResult.addIssue(String) + issueRepository.save(). The DISPLAY statement at the end of MAIN-PARA is replaced with a structured SLF4J log.info() call at INFO level.
